zh-film-en.cb00-01: This is a two-by-two cube. It has only eight little pieces, but scrambled, it can end up in more than three and a half million different ways.
zh-film-en.cb00-02: Can every single one of them be solved? Yes. And all you need is one little move and two algorithms.
zh-film-en.cb00-03: So let's try it together: how do you solve a two-by-two cube?
zh-film-en.cb01-01: First, let's meet it. A two-by-two has no centre pieces. All eight pieces are corners, and each one has three colours.
zh-film-en.cb01-02: The colours come in pairs: white is opposite yellow, green is opposite blue, and red is opposite orange.
zh-film-en.cb01-03: Now a few letters. R is the right layer: looking at it from the right, turn it clockwise.
zh-film-en.cb01-04: Add a little mark, R′, and it turns back the other way. U is the top layer, and U′ turns it back.
zh-film-en.cb01-05: A 2 after a letter means a half turn. And a small y doesn't turn just one layer: you hold the whole cube and turn all of it.
zh-film-en.cb02-01: Step one: finish the bottom layer, with all the white facing down and the side colours of the four corners matching.
zh-film-en.cb02-02: A two-by-two has no centres, so we choose the first corner ourselves. Pick a white corner and hold it at the bottom front right, white facing down.
zh-film-en.cb02-03: Ours is white, green and orange. From now on, the front is green and the right is orange: this one corner decides the colour of every side.
zh-film-en.cb02-04: The next corner is white, green and red. First, turn the whole cube so that its spot comes to the bottom front right.
zh-film-en.cb02-05: Now, just one little move: R U R′ U′. If once isn't enough, do it again.
zh-film-en.cb02-06: On the third time, it drops right in, white facing down!
zh-film-en.cb02-07: The next one, white, red and blue, is up on top. Turn the top to put it right above its spot, then R U R′ U′ again. This one takes five times.
zh-film-en.cb02-08: The last one, white, blue and orange, needs only one. The first layer is done!
zh-film-en.cb02-09: A tip: if a white corner is stuck in the bottom in the wrong spot, turn it to the front right and do R U R′ once to lift it out first.
zh-film-en.cb03-01: White is on the bottom, so yellow is on top. Step two: make the whole top yellow.
zh-film-en.cb03-02: This step uses our first algorithm. It's called Sune: R U R′ U R U2 R′.
zh-film-en.cb03-03: How do you hold the cube? If exactly one top corner shows yellow, turn the top so it sits at the front left.
zh-film-en.cb03-04: If none do, or two do, turn the top until the front-left corner's yellow faces left. Then do Sune.
zh-film-en.cb03-05: Here, none of the top is yellow. Turn the top so the front-left corner's yellow faces left, and do Sune once.
zh-film-en.cb03-06: Now exactly one corner shows yellow, and it's already at the front left. One more Sune… and the whole top is yellow!
zh-film-en.cb04-01: Last step: swap the four top corners into their right places.
zh-film-en.cb04-02: Look at the sides. Is there a side whose two top corners are the same colour? They look like a pair of headlights.
zh-film-en.cb04-03: Turn the headlights to the back, and do the second algorithm: R′ F R′ B2 R F′ R′ B2 R2.
zh-film-en.cb04-04: If no side has headlights, do the algorithm once from anywhere, and they'll appear.
zh-film-en.cb04-05: Finally, turn the top to line it up with the bottom… and it's solved!
zh-film-en.cb05-01: Once more, all the way through: step one, the white layer; step two, a yellow top; step three, the last corners.
zh-film-en.cb05-02: One little move and two algorithms. You can also open this cube on the Lucas Academy website and let it teach you, one step at a time.
zh-film-en.cb06-01: More than three and a half million scrambles, and the same three steps solve every one. So: is there something around you that looks messy and hard, that you could break into small steps and do one at a time? That's what we learn and think about together at Lucas Academy.

en-film-zh.cb00-01: 这是一个二阶魔方。它只有八个小方块，可是打乱以后，能变出三百六十七万多种样子。
en-film-zh.cb00-02: 这么多种样子，每一种都能还原吗？能。而且只要学会一个小动作，再加两个公式。
en-film-zh.cb00-03: 今天，我们就一起来试一试：二阶魔方，怎么还原？
en-film-zh.cb01-01: 先认识一下它。二阶魔方没有中心块，八块都是角块，每一块上有三种颜色。
en-film-zh.cb01-02: 颜色是一对一对的：白色对着黄色，绿色对着蓝色，红色对着橙色。
en-film-zh.cb01-03: 再学几个字母。R 是右边这一层，从右边看，顺时针转一下。
en-film-zh.cb01-04: 加一撇，R′，就是反着转回来。U 是上面这一层，U′ 就是反着转。
en-film-zh.cb01-05: 后面跟一个 2，就是转半圈。小写的 y 呢，不只转一层，而是把整个魔方拿在手里，转一下。
en-film-zh.cb02-01: 第一步，先把底下这一层做好：白色全都朝下，四个角侧面的颜色，也要两两对上。
en-film-zh.cb02-02: 二阶魔方没有中心块，所以第一块角，由我们自己挑。挑一块白色的角，把它放在右下前方，白色朝下。
en-film-zh.cb02-03: 我们挑的这一块是白、绿、橙。从现在起，前面就是绿色，右边就是橙色：每一面该是什么颜色，都跟着它定下来了。
en-film-zh.cb02-04: 下一块是白、绿、红。先转动整个魔方，让它的位置来到右下前方。
en-film-zh.cb02-05: 接下来，只用一个小动作：R U R′ U′。一次不够，就再做一次。
en-film-zh.cb02-06: 做到第三次，它就掉进去了，白色朝下！
en-film-zh.cb02-07: 下一块，白、红、蓝，在上面。先转顶层，把它放到位置的正上方，再做 R U R′ U′。这一块要做五次。
en-film-zh.cb02-08: 最后一块，白、蓝、橙，只要一次。第一层完成了！
en-film-zh.cb02-09: 小提示：要是白色的角卡在下面不对的位置，就把它转到右前方，先做一次 R U R′，把它请出来。
en-film-zh.cb03-01: 白色在下面，黄色就在上面。第二步：让顶面全部变成黄色。
en-film-zh.cb03-02: 这一步用第一个公式，它叫小鱼公式：R U R′ U R U2 R′。
en-film-zh.cb03-03: 怎么拿魔方呢？如果顶上只有一块黄色，就把它转到左前方。
en-film-zh.cb03-04: 要是一块也没有，或者有两块，就转动顶层，让左前方那块角的黄色朝左。然后做小鱼公式。
en-film-zh.cb03-05: 我们这里，顶上一块黄色也没有。转一下顶层，让左前角的黄色朝左，做一次小鱼。
en-film-zh.cb03-06: 现在顶上只有一块黄色，它正好在左前方。再做一次小鱼……顶面全黄了！
en-film-zh.cb04-01: 最后一步：把顶层的四个角，换到正确的位置。
en-film-zh.cb04-02: 先看侧面：有没有哪一面，上面两个角的颜色一样？它们就像一对车头灯。
en-film-zh.cb04-03: 把车头灯转到后面，做第二个公式：R′ F R′ B2 R F′ R′ B2 R2。
en-film-zh.cb04-04: 要是哪一面都没有车头灯，就先在随便哪一面做一次这个公式，车头灯就出来了。
en-film-zh.cb04-05: 最后，转一下顶层，让上下对齐……还原了！
en-film-zh.cb05-01: 再看一遍：第一步，白色的一层；第二步，顶面全黄；第三步，换好四个角。
en-film-zh.cb05-02: 一个小动作，两个公式，就够了。你也可以在 Lucas Academy 的网站上打开这个魔方，让它一步一步教你。
en-film-zh.cb06-01: 三百六十七万种打乱，用的都是同样的三步。那么，你身边有没有一件看起来又乱又难的事，也可以拆成几个小步骤，一步一步来呢？这也是我们在 Lucas Academy 一起学习、一起思考的问题。
